test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Sir, can you reflect on the usefulness or _______ of blocking all the highways?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Futility'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, **"futility"** is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• **"Futility" **means the pointlessness or uselessness of an action.
 
• This **word is used when** an action doesn't produce any useful results, which complements the word** "usefulness" **in the sentence.
 
• The **speaker is asking for** reflection on whether blocking all the highways is useful or pointless.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Sir, can you reflect on the usefulness or **futility **of blocking all the highways?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Impotence"** generally refers to a lack of power or ability, which doesn't fit the context here.
 
• **"Scorch" **means to burn slightly or to cause discoloration due to heat. It's not appropriate in this context.
 
• **"Incompatibility"** refers to the state of two things being so different in nature that they cannot coexist. It does not fit the context here.
